proposed_widenings.name: activation-scoped equipment gate for timed benefits
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can represent charge-based activation, timed duration, grant_sense, and peering_through_item independently, but it cannot express that the granted Truesight is available only while peering through the gem during the 10-minute active window.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "For the next 10 minutes, you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem."

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_gem_of_seeing.dhall because the honest rule requires a duration-limited benefit gated by peering_through_item. Encoding plain timed grant_sense would overstate the item's effect.
